hero.heading: We're excited to meet you.
hero.lead: Thank you for interviewing with Box. This guide helps you learn about our company, prepare with confidence, and find day-of instructions for your interview location.

welcome.label: About us
welcome.heading: A quick hello from Box
welcome.intro: Box powers how the world works together — connecting people with their most important information through secure, intelligent content management. Our interviews are a two-way conversation: we want to learn about you, and we hope you'll learn about us.
welcome.calloutHtml: Day-of logistics (parking, check-in, NDA, lunch) live on your office location page below. Your calendar invite has your exact date, time, and interviewers.
welcome.cardText: Founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Box serves nearly 100,000 organizations globally — including 70% of the Fortune 500. We're building a workplace where people bring their authentic selves to work, collaborate across teams, and create experiences that blow our customers' minds.

prepare.label: Before your interview
prepare.heading: How to best prepare
prepare.intro: Even 15–20 minutes here goes a long way. Focus on what fits your role.

steps.title: Re-read the job description
steps.body: Review responsibilities and required skills. Think of 1–2 real examples from your experience for each major area.

steps.title: Review your work
steps.body: Be ready to walk through a project you're proud of — your role, challenges, and what you learned. Bring samples only if your recruiter requested them.

steps.title: Learn about us
steps.body: Skim the links below — our careers site, product overview, values, and Aaron's video. Genuine curiosity matters more than memorizing facts.

steps.title: Prepare your questions
steps.body: Bring 3–5 questions about the team, the role, how we work, and what success looks like in the first 90 days.

steps.title: Logistics
steps.body:
In-person: open your location page below for address, parking, check-in, and NDA instructions.
Virtual: test camera/mic, find a quiet space, and join 2–3 minutes early via your calendar link.

tips.title: Dress code
tips.body: Business casual — wear what makes you comfortable. Most candidates choose slacks or jeans with a collared shirt or blouse. No suit required unless you prefer one.

tips.title: What to bring (in-person)
tips.body: A valid government-issued photo ID (required for check-in). Notebook and pen are welcome. Only bring a laptop or portfolio if your recruiter requested it.

tips.title: Virtual interviews
tips.body: Laptop or desktop with stable internet, camera, and microphone. Headphones recommended. Have your resume handy as a reference.

tips.title: Timing
tips.body: Arrive 10 minutes early in person. For virtual, join 2–3 minutes before your scheduled start. Running late? Email your Recruiting Coordinator right away.

contact.label: Questions?
contact.heading: Contact your Recruiting Coordinator
contact.body:
Your Recruiting Coordinator is your best point of contact for scheduling, logistics, and interview prep.
Use the email address from your calendar invite or confirmation email.

footer.note: This page is for candidates with scheduled interviews only.

items.question: Lunch
items.answer: If your interview loop includes lunch, your Recruiting Coordinator will confirm the details in advance. Please share any dietary restrictions with your coordinator as early as possible.

items.question: Technology & what to bring
items.answer: Bring a valid government ID (in-person). A notebook and pen are welcome. Only bring a laptop if your recruiter requested a presentation. Please keep your phone on silent during interviews.

items.question: Reasonable accommodation request
items.answer: Box is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates. If you need an accommodation for your interview, please contact your Recruiting Coordinator as soon as possible so we can support you.

items.question: What if I'm running late?
items.answer: Contact your Recruiting Coordinator immediately. We'll do our best to adjust, but some sessions may need to be rescheduled.
